svg.title: GusVoice — self-hosted architecture
svg.desc: Browser, Windows desktop and Android connect over HTTPS and WSS to one Docker Compose host. All audio and video travels through the LiveKit server, never peer to peer. A separate GusVoice server federates using signed HTTP. Android push uses ntfy and UnifiedPush without Google.

g.aria-label: A small stack. Your own place.
g.title: A small stack. Your own place.

g.aria-label: One host for chat, voice, files and push. Optional federation between independent homes.
g.title: One host for chat, voice, files and push. Optional federation between independent homes.

g.aria-label: No P2P — every audio/video stream goes through your server.
g.title: No P2P — every audio/video stream goes through your server.
